description: Stage 3: the router with latency and online learning on the live SuperGPQA answers of the three Claude models (250 questions). Online evaluation: a 30% warm start where every model's answer is known, then a 70% stream graded as it goes (each block routed and scored before it is learned from). The GPT models join once their answers are complete.

router.scales: c, l = mean over models of each model's mean cost / latency; start from the warm start, take in every answer seen
